than usual during training...

text_block_list.text:

My body just won't move the way I want it to...!"

text_block_list.text:

Talk about pathetic...!
choice_data_list: How about taking a short break?

text_block_list.text:

I'm nowhere near done yet—

text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ooh?! I-I tripped?!
What the heck's wrong with me...!
...She seems to be carrying a lot of fatigue. We might need to reconsider her race schedule.
